name: Band Lateral Raise
description: Shoulder strengthener: with the band under one foot, raise both arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.

source.title: British Heart Foundation: resistance band exercises
source.note: Standing version. The article also shows each exercise seated on a chair.

setup: Stand tall with your feet together.
Put the middle of the band under one foot and hold an end in each hand, band taut.
Arms by your sides, elbows slightly bent, palms facing in.
cues: Easier: raise one arm at a time.

prescription.note: Aim for 2 to 3 sessions a week with a rest day between. If you have a heart condition or high blood pressure, check with your doctor or cardiac rehab team first.

keyframes.name: Arms by your sides
keyframes.cue: Elbows soft, band taut from your foot to your hands.

keyframes.name: Raise
keyframes.cue: Lift both arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
